mapper.select: SELECT bi.*, p.name AS material_name, p.code AS material_code FROM wh_bom_item bi LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = bi.material_id WHERE bi.bom_id = #{bomId} ORDER BY bi.item_type ASC

SELECT bi.*, p.name AS material_name, p.code AS material_code, cb.bom_code AS child_bom_code, cb.bom_name AS child_bom_name FROM wh_bom_item bi LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = bi.material_id LEFT JOIN wh_bom cb ON cb.id = bi.child_bom_id WHERE bi.bom_id = #{bomId} ORDER BY bi.item_type ASC
